ash.sessions.management.help: The session list shows background activity without opening conversations. Needs input, Working, Ready for review, Failed and Stopped are management states. Session History shows the state of each branch. Opening a branch preserves the other conversations and drafts.

ash.sessions.github.invalidIssueUrl: Enter an HTTPS issue URL, such as https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123.
ash.sessions.github.issueHelp: Use Attach issue to enter an HTTPS GitHub issue URL. The issues summary shows open, closed and unavailable counts. Press Enter or Space on the summary to expand its links, then use Tab to open or remove an issue. Each link includes its full title and state. Open Accessible View to read all issue states as text. Escape collapses the list and returns focus to the summary. Remove detaches the saved association without closing the issue on GitHub. Unavailable issues remain removable and are not counted as completed.
